name: papercut-setup
description: Install, check or upgrade the papercut toolchain. Runs the doctor, asks how much to set up (Minimal, Standard, Full), then runs install.sh with flags and fixes dependency errors. Use for "set up papercut-explainer", "install papercut", "check my papercut install", "set up the voice", "why won't it render".

findings.excerpt: - Find the repo root (where `install.sh` lives): `readlink` on the installed skill folder ends in `<root>/skills/papercut-setup`. Look in each harness's skills
- What each mode does: Minimal links the skills and the scene-builder agent (into each selected harness's skills and agents folders). Standard adds a dependency
- The installer writes `PAPERCUT_HOME`, `PAPERCUT_LIB`, `PAPERCUT_PY`, `QWEN_TTS_PY` and `ASR_PY` into `~/.config/papercut-explainer/config.env`. An existing sk
| `node` older than 20, or missing | Install Node 20+ (nodejs.org, `brew install node`), then `./install.sh --mode custom --components deps,verify --yes`. |
| `ffmpeg` missing | `brew install ffmpeg` or `apt install ffmpeg`. |
| Voice venv: "need Python 3.10-3.12" | Qwen3-TTS has no wheels for newer Python. Install `uv` (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) or `brew install python@3.12`, rerun
